source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT (SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Oracle_Source_ContainerName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_dbsmrt_database_inventory_data_import' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'load_import_table') AS Load_import_table_OracleSource_ContainerName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Oracle_Source_FileName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_dbsmrt_database_inventory_data_import' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'load_import_table') AS Load_import_table_OracleSource_FileName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Oracle_Source_FilePath' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_dbsmrt_database_inventory_data_import' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'load_import_table') AS Load_import_table_OracleSource_FilePath,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Target_import_table_ContainerName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_dbsmrt_database_inventory_data_import' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'load_import_table') AS Load_import_table_Targetimporttable_ContainerName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Target_import_table_FileName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_dbsmrt_database_inventory_data_import' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'load_import_table') AS Load_import_table_Targetimporttable_FileName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Target_import_table_FilePath' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_dbsmrt_database_inventory_data_import' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'load_import_table') AS Load_import_table_Targetimporttable_FilePath,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Load_import_table0_sink_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_dbsmrt_database_inventory_data_import') AS Load_import_table0_sink_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Load_import_table0_sink_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'ppl_etpp_oracle_datalake_dbsmrt_database_inventory_data_import') AS Load_import_table0_sink_TableName;

FirstPart_SQL.defaultValue: SELECT DISTINCT       b.INSTANCE_ID     , b.INSTANCE_ENTERPRISE_ID     , b.INSTANCE_STATUS     , b.INSTANCE_NAME     , b.INSTANCE_TYPE     , b.INSTANCE_ENVIRONMENT     , b.INSTANCE_SUPPORT_GROUP     , b.database_name     , b.database_id     , b.dbms     , b.DATABASE_STATUS     , b.database_type     , b.database_environment     , b.database_support_group     , b.database_size     , b.database_encryption_status     , b.database_goldengate_status     , b.database_oracle_datavault_status     , b.database_description     , b.database_created_datetime     , b.database_last_updated_datetime     , b.database_last_discovery_run_datetime     , enterprise_mainframe_Distributed_id     , host_name     , tsc_name     , f.u_tsc_version_group     , f.u_tsc_lifecycle     , f.u_technopedia_product_id     , f.u_vendor_end_of_life     , e.enterprise_id AS BUSINESS_APPLICATION_WF_GUID     , b.database_business_interest     , b.database_business_interest_entry_type     , b.eapp_dct_business_effective_date     , b.database_business_interest_indicator     , b.instance_business_interest_indicator     , a.APPLICATION_DATABASE_CERTIFICATION_STATUS     , b.instance_discovered_version     , b.DATABASE_ENTERPRISE_ID  FROM ITM_DBSMRT.INVENTORY b INNER JOIN ITM_DBSMRT.inventory_host c     ON b.INSTANCE_ID = c.INSTANCE_ID LEFT JOIN ITM_DBSMRT.inventory_database_application_relationship a     ON a.DATABASE_ID = b.DATABASE_ID LEFT JOIN ITM_DBSMRT.APPLICATION e     ON a.application_id = e.application_id LEFT JOIN ITM_CURATED.ITMP_SOFTWARE_PRODUCT_MODEL f     ON b.instance_enterprise_product_id = f.u_technopedia_product_id    AND f.u_tsc_version_group IS NOT NULL    AND f.u_tsc_lifecycle = 'MAINSTREAM' WHERE b.DATABASE_STATUS NOT IN ('RETIRED')   AND b.INSTANCE_STATUS NOT IN ('RETIRED')
